manifest.cfg.title: Codex History Viewer
manifest.cfg.sessionsRoot: Root folder of Codex sessions. Leave empty to use the default (~/.codex/sessions).
manifest.cfg.codexArchivedSessionsRoot: Root folder used when Sources: Enabled includes Codex and Codex Archived Sessions: Enabled is on. Leave empty to use a sibling archived_sessions folder next to the Codex sessions root.
manifest.cfg.codexArchivedSessionsEnabled: Load Codex archived_sessions in addition to normal Codex sessions when Sources: Enabled includes Codex. When enabled, the Archived Sessions Root setting below determines which archive folder is read.
manifest.cfg.claudeSessionsRoot: Root folder of Claude Code sessions. Leave empty to use the default (~/.claude/projects).
manifest.cfg.branchNavigationEnabled: Experimental setting. Enable Branch Navigation for locally forked Codex histories and Claude Code histories created with Fork conversation. Codex forks created in a new worktree are not supported. Off by default.
manifest.cfg.sourcesEnabled: Select one or more history sources to use in History, Pinned, and Search. Removing Codex also disables the Codex archived-session settings.
manifest.cfg.handoffEnabled: Show cross-agent handoff actions for visible Codex and Claude Code sessions. Turning this off hides handoff creation, copy, and open actions, but handoff-file deletion and status information remain available.
manifest.cfg.previewOpenOnSelection: Open a reusable session preview in the editor area when selecting a tree item.
manifest.cfg.previewMaxMessages: Maximum number of user/assistant messages collected for detailed tree item tooltips. This is not a guaranteed visible count. VS Code limits hover height to about 50% of the window, so some collected messages may be outside the visible area when the tooltip is long.
manifest.cfg.previewTooltipMode: Choose how much information session tree item tooltips show.
manifest.cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumFull: Show date, source, CWD, tags/note, message excerpts, and action help.
manifest.cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumCompact: Show metadata only, without message excerpts or action help.
manifest.cfg.previewTooltipMode.enumTitleOnly: Show only the same one-line text shown in the tree item.
manifest.cfg.searchMaxResults: Set the maximum number of hits collected by one search.
manifest.cfg.searchCaseSensitive: Choose whether searches distinguish uppercase and lowercase letters.
manifest.cfg.searchDefaultRoles: Select one or more message roles to use in searches.
manifest.cfg.searchIndexToolContent: Choose how much tool content is stored in the search index. Including tool content can help File AI Change History prioritize related sessions.
manifest.cfg.searchIndexToolContent.enumConversat: Search only user, assistant, and developer messages. File AI Change History still works, but related-session prioritization may be less precise because file-name hints are limited.
manifest.cfg.searchIndexToolContent.enumToolCalls: Search messages plus tool names and arguments, without tool output.
Search messages, tool names/arguments, and tool output.
manifest.cfg.deleteUseTrash: Move session files to the OS trash/recycle bin for delete actions from History, Pinned, Search, or the Command Palette (recommended). When disabled, delete them permanently.
manifest.cfg.resumeOpenTarget: How 'Resume in Codex' opens the session (sidebar or panel). Default is sidebar.
manifest.cfg.resumeOpenTarget.enumSidebar: Resume in the Codex sidebar (recommended default).
manifest.cfg.resumeOpenTarget.enumPanel: Resume in a Codex panel tab.
manifest.cfg.uiLanguage: Choose the display language used by this extension. Auto follows VS Code's display language.
manifest.cfg.uiTimeGuideEnabled: Show the date guide and bookmark actions in session views and File AI Change History.
manifest.cfg.uiAlwaysShowHeaderActions: Always show view header action icons (sets VS Code setting 'workbench.view.alwaysShowHeaderActions').
manifest.cfg.historyDateBasis: Choose which session date is used by the history tree and date-based search filters.
manifest.cfg.historyDateBasis.enumStarted: Group history and apply date filters using the session start date.
manifest.cfg.historyDateBasis.enumLastActivity: Group history and apply date filters using the latest session activity date.
manifest.cfg.historyTitleSource: Choose how session titles are displayed.
manifest.cfg.historyTitleSource.enumGenerated: Create titles from the session content.
manifest.cfg.historyTitleSource.enumNativeWhenAva: Prefer title metadata from Codex or Claude Code when available, and otherwise create titles from the session content.
manifest.cfg.sessionRowShowTimestamp: Show the timestamp in session rows in History, Pinned, and Search. When hidden, the timestamp remains available in the tooltip.
manifest.cfg.sessionRowShowProject: Show the project alias or path in session rows in History, Pinned, and Search. When hidden, the project information remains available in the tooltip.
manifest.cfg.fileChangeHistoryExplorerContextMenu: Show 'File AI Change History' in file context menus in the VS Code sidebar file list.
manifest.cfg.webview.restoreAfterReload: Experimental. After Reload Window or a VS Code restart, restore open session tabs (including the reusable preview), File AI Change History, History Insights, and the dedicated Settings page. Session tabs and history views also restore their view positions. Restoration is asynchronous and may appear later; opening the same history before it finishes can create duplicate tabs. Tabs whose original session or target file is missing are not restored. This is off by default, and changes take effect after the next Reload Window or VS Code restart.
manifest.cfg.autoRefreshEnabled: Watch session folders and automatically refresh history after file changes. This is off by default to avoid adding background watchers.
manifest.cfg.autoRefreshDebounceMs: Wait this long after detecting session file changes before refreshing. Multiple changes during the wait are merged into one refresh.
manifest.cfg.autoRefreshMinIntervalMs: Minimum interval between automatic history refreshes.
manifest.cfg.chatOpenPosition: Choose where a session opens in the session view when switching back to it.
manifest.cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumTop: Open from the top when no target message is specified.
manifest.cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumLastMessage: Restore near the last viewed message.
manifest.cfg.chatOpenPosition.enumLatest: Open at the latest rendered card.
manifest.cfg.chatPerformanceMode: Choose the default session view performance mode. Auto switches based on session size and diff count, Normal View preserves view state as much as possible, and Lightweight View loads diffs and details on demand.
manifest.cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumAuto: Automatically choose Normal View or Lightweight View based on history size and diff count.
manifest.cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumNormal: Preserve the view state as much as possible. Large sessions may take longer to load or switch back to.
manifest.cfg.chatPerformanceMode.enumSimplified: Load diffs and details on demand, and lighten heavy rendered sections when the view is restored.
manifest.cfg.chatToolDisplayMode: Choose how tool activity is shown in the history view.
manifest.cfg.chatToolDisplayMode.enumDetailsOnly: Keep the current behavior. Tool items appear only when details are shown.
manifest.cfg.chatToolDisplayMode.enumCompactCards: Always show tool cards, while 'Show details' only controls raw tool details and notes.
manifest.cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding: Choose how long user messages are collapsed in the history view.
manifest.cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumOff: Keep the current behavior. User messages are always fully expanded.
manifest.cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumAuto: Collapse only long user messages when details are hidden.
manifest.cfg.chatUserLongMessageFolding.enumAlway: Always start eligible user messages collapsed when details are hidden.
manifest.cfg.chatAssistantLongMessageFolding: Choose how long assistant messages are collapsed in the history view.
manifest.cfg.chatAssistantLongMessageFolding.enum: Keep the current behavior. Assistant messages are always fully expanded.
Collapse only long assistant messages when details are hidden.
Always start eligible assistant messages collapsed when details are hidden.
manifest.cfg.chatStickyUserPrompt: Show the current user prompt summary as a sticky header in the history view. Already-open history views are not updated immediately; reload or reopen the history view after changing this setting.
manifest.cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode: Choose the turn display for Codex and Claude Code sessions. Basic shows turn boundaries, duration, item and token summaries, and completed-turn folding. Live also enables running turns, elapsed-time updates, activity cues, and a fixed locator for the running position.
manifest.cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumOff: Do not add turn timeline UI.
manifest.cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumBasic: Show turn start/end markers, range rails, duration, item/token summaries, and manual folding for completed turns. Live running indicators and elapsed live updates are disabled.
manifest.cfg.chatTurnTimelineMode.enumLive: Add running turn indicators, elapsed live updates, activity cues, and a fixed locator on top of Basic.
manifest.cfg.imagesEnabled: Show supported image attachments in the history view.
manifest.cfg.imagesMaxSizeMB: Set the maximum image file size loaded for preview and saving. Images over the limit cannot be previewed or saved.
manifest.cfg.imagesThumbnailSize: Choose the thumbnail size used for image attachments in the history view.
manifest.cfg.debugLoggingEnabled: Write diagnostic timing logs to the Codex History Viewer output channel. Logs include counts and durations, not session paths or message content.

manifest.cfg.agentRunsEnabled: Experimental setting. Enable Agent Runs for Codex and Claude Code sessions. Sub-agent sessions with a verified, available parent are shown through Agent Runs instead of the History list. Search and statistics include their own records regardless of this setting. Off by default.
manifest.cfg.resumeCodexMethod: Choose the resume actions for Codex sessions. CLI only enters a command in a new integrated terminal, so press Enter to run it. With Extension and CLI, the last successful method becomes the main button.
manifest.cfg.resumeClaudeMethod: Choose the resume actions for Claude Code sessions. CLI only enters a command in a new integrated terminal, so press Enter to run it. With Extension and CLI, the last successful method becomes the main button.
manifest.cfg.resumeMethod.enumExtension: Show only the extension resume action.
manifest.cfg.resumeMethod.enumCli: Show only the action that enters a CLI resume command in a new integrated terminal. Press Enter to run it.
manifest.cfg.resumeMethod.enumBoth: Show a split button for both methods, with the last successful method as the main action.
manifest.config.codexCompressedSessionsEnabled: Include compressed Codex histories (.jsonl.zst; experimental, off by default). Decompression can increase CPU and memory usage. Expanded files are not saved to disk.
